component.0: {name} exists, but it is failing and nobody trusts what it reports.
component.2: {name} is done by hand, whenever someone remembers.
component.3: {name} runs from scripts that someone has to start.
component.5: {name} runs automatically, is monitored, and has a clear owner.

edge.0: The hand over from {source} to {target} is broken.
edge.2: Someone moves work from {source} to {target} by hand.
edge.3: A script moves work from {source} to {target} when started ({trigger}).
edge.5: Work flows from {source} to {target} automatically ({trigger}), with checks and an owner.

data.validation.2: Dave eyeballs new data dumps in a notebook before anyone trains on them.
data.validation.4: Every incoming batch is validated against the schema before it is stored.
data.validation.4|tool=great_expectations: Great Expectations validates every incoming batch before it is stored.
data.validation.4|sourcing=bought|tool=great_expectation: A licensed Great Expectations setup validates every incoming batch, maintained by the vendor.

deploy.serving.2: The model is served from a hand started process on a single machine.
deploy.serving.4|hosting=on_prem: The model serves live traffic from the on premises cluster.
deploy.serving.4|hosting=public_cloud: The model serves live traffic from a public cloud endpoint.

e.fs_train.2: Someone exports features to a CSV and hands it to the training job.
e.fs_train.4|trigger=on_data_arrival: New features arriving in the store start a training run on their own.
